Visual reviews and certification evidence use the centralized external data directory outside Git to protect repository hygiene.
Windows Sandbox is unavailable on the current Windows 11 Home host; Phase 16 clean-install certification was completed successfully using an isolated Windows 11 Pro VirtualBox VM.

Cross-platform desktop certification is now a mandatory POST-OCR gate (explicit user authority, 2026-09-17). Windows Stage 1 remains certified (30/30 invariants, historical). Arch Linux, Ubuntu LTS, and macOS remain NOT_STARTED and must be certified after OCR implementation and verification, before final release certification.

Real-engine smoke testing is hardware-bound: Unlimited-OCR upstream documents NVIDIA GPU/CUDA inference only and this host has no CUDA device, so P17 real-engine verification for English is BLOCKED BY CURRENT HARDWARE. The adapter, runtime, and contract layers are mock-tested and pass.

PP-OCRv5 CPU runtime is now unblocked by a proven pin set: paddlepaddle 3.0.0, paddleocr 3.3.1, paddlex 3.3.13, numpy 1.26.4, scipy 1.13.1, scikit-learn 1.5.2, langchain<0.3 and setuptools. The shipped driver loaded PP-OCRv5_server_det and arabic_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec and returned real synthetic inference output with confidence 0.9969695210456848. PaddlePaddle 3.3.1 remains deliberately unused because of its PIR/oneDNN CPU failure. This is runtime/provider evidence only, not representative benchmark acceptance evidence.

Staged-update integrity verification detects post-staging corruption using hashes recorded at staging time; upstream publishes no independent release checksums for these engines, so this is not a supply-chain attestation.

P17-T002 benchmark material (corpus images, real ground truth, run output, fonts) lives only under READ_WATCH_DATA_ROOT/ocr/benchmark/ and is never committed; Git carries schema, algorithms, tests, documentation, and a 14-sample authored synthetic starter corpus in text form.

The synthetic starter corpus proves plumbing only. It is not representative of real books and is not sufficient for final accuracy acceptance; no engine has been benchmarked yet (P17-T004 outstanding).

The mandatory Urdu Nastaliq specialist qandeelasim13/urdu-ocr-trocr-si26 is now INTEGRATED (provider id urdu-nastaliq-trocr, pinned revision a9ef072320b50014f6df7ed9db807810157a410e, LINE-only) and Urdu runs as a mandatory dual-engine pipeline with no fallback. Urdu is reported COMPLETE only when BOTH engines complete; one engine yields PARTIAL_ENGINE_FAILURE.

The specialist's project repository declares no licence file and its training data includes UTRSet-Real (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) material; weight and dataset terms must be reviewed before any redistribution or commercial use. Read & Watch bundles no weights, commits no weights, and claims no redistribution right.

Real specialist smoke test executed 2026-09-17 (SMOKE TEST ONLY, not benchmark evidence): the shipped driver loaded the exact pinned revision on CPU with Python 3.12.10, torch 2.14.0+cpu, transformers 5.17.0 and ran a synthetic line fixture; model.safetensors matched the published upstream sha256 byte-for-byte. Evidence under READ_WATCH_DATA_ROOT/ocr/evidence/smoke/.

P17-T004 representative private real-world corpus is still unavailable. The committed 14-sample synthetic corpus proves benchmark plumbing only, no human-validated real-world ground truth was created in this run, and Unlimited-OCR remains blocked by the absence of CUDA hardware. P17-T004 and P17-G002 remain open.

Derived OCR text is now searchable in book-local reader search and every hit is provenance-tagged (NATIVE_TEXT vs OCR_DERIVED); pages with usable native text are never duplicated from OCR. Reader-side OCR text is derived evidence, not document text.
Producing a benchmark image from a PDF page is not automated: the importer ingests an already-selected page/region/line image. No image or cropping library was added to the repository.
